earlier_scan.source_named: Ozanne-Rivierre, Françoise. 1998. Le Nyelâyu de Balade (Nouvelle-Calédonie) (grammar sketch + dictionary, 276pp). Book not found online.

sources.citation: McCracken, Chelsea Leigh. 2012. A grammar of Belep. PhD dissertation, Rice University (hdl 1911/71287).
sources.note: Describes stress for Belep (nyal1254, the sister Nyalayu language): 'Belep has primarily fixed stress on the penultimate syllable' (sec. 2.7, pp. 133-144). Mentions Balade Nyelâyu (Ozanne-Rivierre 1998) only for segmental facts (32 consonants, phonemic vowel length, prenasalised stops); says nothing about Balade stress.

sources.citation: Bril, Isabelle. 1998. Review of Ozanne-Rivierre, Françoise, 1998, Le nyelâyu de Balade (Nouvelle-Calédonie). Journal de la Société des Océanistes 107 (1998-2): 244.
sources.note: Nothing on stress or accent. Confirms the book contains 'une présentation de la phonologie, une esquisse grammaticale' and notes that aspirated consonants tend to be realised as a low tone which does not become a phonemic feature.

sources.citation: WALS Online, language Nyelâyu (nyl), source Ozanne-Rivierre 1998; Grambank, Balade (bala1316), sources Ozanne-Rivierre 1998, 2004.
sources.note: WALS page for Nyelâyu has no feature values at all (stress chapters 14-17 not coded); Grambank has no stress feature. Both confirm Ozanne-Rivierre 1998 as the descriptive source.

sources.citation: Wikipedia EN 'Nyâlayu language' and FR 'Nyelâyu' (phonology sections cited to Ozanne-Rivierre 1998).
sources.note: Consonant and vowel inventories plus the remark that aspiration is a prosodic trait lowering the voice register; nothing on stress placement.

sources.citation: Rivierre, Jean-Claude. 1994. Contact-induced phonological complexification in New Caledonia. In T. Dutton & D. T. Tryon (eds), Language Contact and Change in the Austronesian World, 497-522. Berlin: Mouton de Gruyter.
sources.note: Discusses prosodic systems (aspiration, tone, accent) of northern New Caledonian languages; possible accent statement for Nyelâyu.

sources.citation: Corne, J. C. 2000. Review of Ozanne-Rivierre 1998, Le Nyelâyu de Balade. Bulletin of the School of Oriental and African Studies 63(1): 151.
